en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a public park with a modernist fountain in the foreground. The fountain shows a crouching human figure holding up a large bowl from which water spills in thin vertical streams into a square basin. In the background are manicured hedges, a walkway with a few people, and historic buildings including a square defensive tower and a tall, slender church spire rising above trees and houses. The print has a white border with slightly deckled edges, typical of early–mid‑20th‑century postcards. No printed caption is visible on the front.
